result.summary: The page is generally well-rendered, but there are a couple of visible clipping and overlap issues in the mobile layout.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its associated content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or ensure the page scrolls far enough that cards are not hidden behind the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category and restaurant carousels are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partial category chip and truncated restaurant title.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel behavior if intentional, but add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance or adjust spacing so the partial next item looks deliberate and does not truncate important text.
